mentl/4b74b33:
The section already convicted the received fan five ways and already stated the
target shape. What it never said was what the MECHANISM is, and a survey of the
2026 literature says why that gap matters: it is not Mentl's private failure,
it is the field's.

Five areas, five communities, one limit — the artifacts of reasoning are
discarded between phases. Smyth/Scrybe propagate a SPEC (examples) through the
sketch, not the judgment. LLM synthesis generates then verifies then repairs, so
verification is a post-hoc filter and every candidate is judged whole. E-graph
extraction is NP-hard over an arbitrary DAG cost and handles side effects by
RELAXING THE CFG SKELETON, an approximation bolted on because the IR has no
effect algebra. POPL 2026 discharged rows = capabilities and nobody carries
negation into it. Disambiguation clusters candidates and asks a max-information-
gain multiple-choice query, whose own authors name clustering quality and
candidate-count scaling as the limits. Every one is the Carried-Truth Law at the
search layer.

THE FORM: a `??` is a cell whose binding is undetermined, which is what every
unresolved type variable already is — and Mentl owns that machine (union-find,
monotone narrowing, trail-backed checkpoints). Make the hole a term cell in the
SAME union-find and four aspirations become mechanism: propagation precedes
enumeration (ill-typed candidates are never CONSTRUCTED); forking happens only
at genuine disjunction, form-variants being congruence classes, so the fan's
width IS the disjunction count; shared context is free because branches are
trail SEGMENTS over one graph — no sharing protocol, nothing to share — and
lemma-sharing is promotion below the checkpoint, sound as clause-sharing in
portfolio SAT.

Stated precisely rather than as a slogan, because the slogan would be false:
this is CLP-style propagation with DISJUNCTION AS A LAYER ABOVE the cell
substrate. Plain unification is not confluent for terms. What is shared is the
substrat

mentl/4bb70bb:
selfapply f = f(f) trapped the compiler: chase_deep and subst_ty spun
to stack exhaustion with zero occurs reports, because the occurs leaf
compared handles while the cycle lived in bound structure — bind
a := TFun([b], r) first (b free, passes every comparison), close
b := TVar(a) after; no handle compare sees it, only descending a's
binding does.

The leaf now answers the real question — does handle occur in the
type graph reachable from here: raw handle, then root (union-find),
then the root's binding recursed (NBound and NRecordRowBound;
TRecordOpen's rest symmetric). Termination is the guarded-write
invariant itself: every bind runs the check, so the graph stays
acyclic and the recursion bottoms out. chase_deep carries a depth-200
tripwire as the belt behind the suspender — a firing names the shape
by constructor tag, since show_type on a cycle would itself spin
(measured).

The probe arc was mechanical: the tag probe named the cycle
(TVar(3)/TVar(19)) and the occurs-fire probe proved the guards never
ran. Wheel compile time unchanged.

E_OccursCheck arms — the eighth. The fixture that found the trap now
gates it: the infinite type reports and refuses, exit 1, zero WAT.
Hβ.infer.selfapply-cyclic-ty-spin closed same-day.

mentl/4b4174c:
The cardinality inference (985d55e) decides that a continuation forks;
this proves HOW the fork runs. A multi-shot handler is a driver over
re-runs: resume(v) is a fresh cont.new(body) resumed to the suspend
then resumed with v. Native WASM typed continuations are linear
(resuming one twice panics wasmtime — verified), so multi-shot is
re-execution, one fresh cont per fork. suspend unwinds the perform to
the driver level, so the arm runs outside the body's stack — no
re-entrancy.

Crucibles (tests/native-cont/, run under -W stack-switching): twice
over pick() -> 3; over pick()+5 -> 13 (the continuation after the
perform is captured natively, not a return-the-input stub); the model
in Mentl source -> 30 through boot. Correct for identity, non-identity,
and no-perform bodies.

Also records the measurement lesson that cleared the path: wasmtime
aliases every proc_exit code >= 127 to 1, so exit-code test harnesses
must keep values under 127 or read the printed value. The apparent
'non-tail resume bug' was entirely this aliasing; the handler machinery
is correct.

Emit target fully specced in tests/native-cont/README.md; the remaining
work is the emit integration (op->tag, perform->suspend, resume->rerun,
wasm-tools for multi-shot modules), de-risked by the end-to-end proof.
Bands B peer Hbeta.continuations.multishot-reexecution-driver updated to
PROVEN.

stoop/4bf02e1:
Every back cover's code points at the scene's address and the issue's
number, and nothing in the press made anything to put there. The shelf
now writes that folder as a zip: each issue's file at its number, a PDF of
it beside it at exact paper size for whoever prints, the newest issue at
the root and at latest/, and a note on where to put it. Nothing in it names
its own host, so it can be dropped on Neocities, Netlify Drop, any static
host or a thumb drive and the codes land.

The zip is written by hand, deflated where the browser can and stored
where it cannot. test/14-site reads it back entry by entry with node's own
zlib, checks every size and checksum, and opens the front door from the
unzipped folder.
